dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous reduction in 2D width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white skin tone with a median-high pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary light-toned dorsal canvas and the slightly darker lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast, dark circular point disruption located on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear, high-frequency longitudinal ridge visible along the central axis of the posterior peduncle.
